title: Pan-Fried Ukrainian Dumplings with Mushroom and Kick Sauce
description: A hearty Ukrainian dish filled with sautéed mushrooms and served with a spicy kick sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the mushrooms and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Ukrainian dumplings to the pan and cook for about 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings with the sautéed mushrooms and a side of kicky sauce (see below).
To make kicky sauce, mix together 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil, 1 tablespoon of hot sauce, and 1 tablespoon of sour cream. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
